newsitem.title: JAPAN: Land liquidity plan lifts Japan real estate shares.
newsitem.headline: Land liquidity plan lifts Japan real estate shares.

text.p: Comments from Japan's Finance Ministry that the government would draw up a plan to improve land liquidity by the end of March boosted shares in the real estate sector 0#REA.T on Tuesday morning, brokers said.
As of 0040 GMT, Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd and Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd shares were both up 30 yen at 1,300 yen and 1,400 yen respectively.

As for effective use of land, Mitsuzuka said the scheme would help elevate the usefulness of land by having collateralised land used for the public benefit. He did not explicitly touch on whether and how public funds would be used in the scheme.

Asked whether he thought announcing the scheme at the end of the fiscal year would have a good impact on the stock market, Mitsuzuka said: "It just happened to be at the end of this month, but as a result what you have said may happen."
